criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Mostly passes the bespoke bar; frame 4 the one showstopper; frame 2 a working measured relief. Six frames fall short: frame 8 boxy tables, lumpy vinyl noise, no visible roll or curl, pills on the vinyl, a grey brown lower band; frame 7 a clipped white coat, jagged hair, the chair cutting the figure, c11 c7 over the chair, a flat bench shadow block; frame 9 laptops floating on an offset shadow, binder in a halo, subject under half the frame; frame 1 mannequins and a stray cyan shard beside the glass; frame 6 slips in a thin strip under haze, sand, toy pen; frame 5 an empty slab face in the bottom fifth.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: The spine holds and the tab counter carries 5 to 7; the cover's pink lilac sky and frame 8's peach sit at the palette's edge; the accent nears two meanings on frames 1 and 4.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; AMA figures attributed; no implied result; all primary; the caption's present tense sits against the release's will have.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and how clear; the stake general; no city, timeline or results date.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, the turn at 5; frame 4 repeats the cover body; the close is the least drawn frame.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and in house style but close to the release; drawn to illustrate repeats as boilerplate; thin Texas specificity.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A fresh concept mixing cutaway, reliefs and still lifes; the blue sweep and the receding instrument to a cyan laptop on 5 and 7 are familiar.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 8 as real clinic hardware with dispenser bars and head rolls, crepe that curls at a free end, kick base cabinets and the year pills on the sweep, since it carries the only measured comparison.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Boxy tables with lumpy vinyl noise, no visible roll or curl, pills on the vinyl, a dead peach lower band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Chrome dispenser bar and roll at each head, a curled free end with its own shadow, a stitched vinyl seam, pills on the sweep, camera in about 20 percent.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Clipped white coat, jagged hair alpha, the chair cutting the body, c11 c7 over the chair, a flat bench shadow block.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the key on the coat with fold normals, fix the hair and chair intersection, swing the camera so the figure clears the claim id corner.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Laptops hover on an offset shadow and the binder sits in a halo, under half the frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Set both on a desk with tight contact shadows from one key and push in until they fill half the frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A stray cyan shard beside the glass, mannequins, flat floors, the cutaway under half the frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Delete the shard or make it a real reflection of both monitors; lower and enlarge the cutaway to meet the footer.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Slips in a thin strip under haze, sand, a toy pen.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at about 25 degrees pushed in on a chipped limestone lip, a satin pen with a tight contact shadow.
